description:
Generalized assignment branch-and-bound (MTG):
- Bounding: Compute knapsack-based upper and lower bounds.
- Branching: Branch by fixing or forbidding task-resource assignments; prune subproblems dominated by current best solution.
- Configuration: Set back=-1 for exact search. Supports up to 10 resources and 100 tasks.
